claim: `key-names-one-property` runs at change, and a landing that created a collision it judges was not refused by it. `9bb4d31724a` added `location-description` keying `description`, which `page` has keyed since 2026-09-15, and the same landing carried `game-location.page-type.ts`, rewrote that page type's declarations file, and carries no `Checks-bypassed` trailer, so the checks ran over the very page the refusal names. The check answered nought refusals for 93 rounds running and then one, eight minutes later, at audit. So a gate that runs at change let through what the audit caught over the same tree. Why is not settled here.

evidence:
Read 2026-09-21 against this checkout.

WHAT THE CHECK STATES. `key-names-one-property.check-code.ts` states `runsOnChange: true`, `runsOnDeploy: true` and `runsOnAudit: true`, and carries no `experimental`.

THE COLLISION AND WHEN IT AROSE. `page/properties/description.text-property.ts` keys `description` and last moved at `b59ce8b2b5c` on 2026-09-15. `story/game/location/properties/location-description.text-property.ts` keys `description` too and arrived at `9bb4d31724a`, 2026-09-21 17:19:26 -0600. `story/game/location/game-location.page-type.ts` declares `text-property/location-description` and reaches `page` by extension, so from that landing on, one key names two properties.

THAT THE LANDING CARRIED THE JUDGED PAGE. `git show --stat 9bb4d31724a` names `story/game/location/game-location.page-type.ts` among its files, which is the path the audit refusal names, and also names `story/game/location/game-location.page-type.schema.jsonl` with four lines added. That file is what `declarationsOf` answers from, so the declarations the check reads were rewritten by the same landing rather than left behind it.

THAT THE CHECKS RAN. The commit message of `9bb4d31724a` is its subject, a `Co-Authored-By` line and a `Claude-Session` line. There is no `Checks-bypassed` trailer, and `git/modules/committing/committing.module.code.ts` writes that trailer for every landing that runs no check, `change-mechanical` and `change-none` among them.

WHEN IT WAS TOLD. The audit logs beside the check hold 93 rounds answering nought refusals, the last at 2026-09-21T22:53:34Z, and then one refusal at 23:27:33Z. The landing was 23:19:26Z. The refusal reads that the page keys `description` to `text-property/location-description` declared by `game-location` and to `text-property/description` declared by `page`.

WHAT WAS READ AND DID NOT SETTLE IT. The change entry is `refusalsIn` in `key-names-one-property.check-code.check.code.ts`, which takes `carriedBy(change, shadow.index.pageTypesIn())` and answers nothing where that is empty, then hands the rest through `judgedIn`, `underEach` and `refusalsOver`. `underEach` walks down, taking `shadow.index.kindsUnder(one.slug)` for each carried page type, so it adds page types beneath a carried one and never the page types above it. That does not by itself account for the miss, because `game-location` was carried in its own right and `collisionsIn` runs over each held page type, resolving through `declaringIn`, which for a page type answers `shadow.index.declarationsOf(one.slug)` — the whole declared set, inherited entries and all. `judgedIn` keeps a carried page only where `shadow.index.kindsUnder(PAGE_TYPE)` holds the page's own kind, which for a page type's own page is `page-type`; whether that set holds `page-type` itself was not read, and it is the first thing to read next.

NOT ESTABLISHED. No run reproduces this. The check was not run over a change carrying those files, and nothing here shows the change phase answering nothing where the audit answers one. The reading above is of the code and of the commits rather than of a run, and the miss may have a cause none of it names.
